releaseNotes:
rc.8 — Multi-source update with timely polling.

• Primary: jsDelivr CDN (auto-purged on release)
• Fallback: GitHub Releases API
• Polling: every 4 hours via Timer
• Initial check: 5s after launch
• Manual check: ⌘U menu
• ↑ indicator when update available
• Release script: ./release.sh <version>
